turns.text: Hi, I would like to book a tattoo.
I can help you start a tattoo booking. Please tell me the design idea, the size, where on the body you would like it, and when you are available. A colleague will then take over the booking.
The idea is a small paper boat, about 8 cm wide, on the outside of my left forearm. I can come on weekday evenings.

Thank you. I have passed your tattoo booking to a colleague with the idea (a small paper boat), the size (about 8 cm wide), the placement (outside of your left forearm) and your weekday evening availability. A colleague will take over from here.

input.summary: Customer wants a tattoo booking. Idea: small paper boat. Size: about 8 cm wide. Placement: outside of left forearm. Availability: weekday evenings. No price or date given.
